youtube.title: How many 8000m peaks are in Nepal? Most people guess too low 🧗
youtube.description:
Only a handful of mountains on Earth rise above eight thousand metres, and one small Himalayan country holds more of them than anyone else. Some stand on its borders with China and India; a few rise entirely inside it. The tallest of all is measured to the metre by both countries that share it.
Which did you pick?
